notes.title: Launch Date Reveal!
notes.notes: [p]Choo Choo Engineers! [/p][p]It's been an amazing journey, and it is now time to reveal the launch date, which is the 27th of October, so only five weeks from now till we can get our train out of the depot![/p][p]I'm hard at work on the choo choo rail road and I'll soon have Steam achievements (about 60 achievements at launch) created for the full game. notes.title: Regular boss first, then optional guard tower survival!
notes.notes: [p]Choo Choo Engineers![/p][p]I've moved the guard tower track section to after the regular boss. I think it was a bit troublesome trying to avoid activating the survival challenge while fighting the regular boss so I wanted to fix that gameplay issue. So now you will encounter the regular boss first, and just before the end of the level you will come across the guard tower and you can then choose to activate it if you want to do the survival challenge.[/p][p]Let me know what you think of the change![/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]GTGD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/dca2f34a7c67c5f02ba5ef11eb48bddc082f03d1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes: [p][b]Choo Choo Engineers![/b][/p][p align="start"]We’ve reached our demo launch milestone, which means we’re getting much closer to a full release, most likely in late October! I’m really excited we’ve made it this far, and I want to thank everyone who played [i]Choo Choo Survivor 2[/i]. A special thanks goes to those who shared feedback and especially to the volunteers who helped translate the game.[/p][p align="start"]I’ve also given the cow catcher and its minigun a big power boost! It now feels a lot more satisfying to smash through a horde of monsters.[/p][p align="start"]Looking ahead, I’m steadily making progress on the primary weapons, bosses, and other content that will be ready for the full launch.[/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]GTGD[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/413a8466de38f727413d18830131a9ca07f15c31.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/5105aa9dcfbed3fdcb25503183ae23421298ea09.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/7c87ab0095f1f47144c83813386f88a105a2709b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Brand new camera system! Smooth background and enemy scrolling
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/e4aef31c739b73f5d1be517a39d96024c8b53660.gif"][/img][/p][p]Choo Choo Engineers![/p][p]I've built a new camera system for Choo Choo Survivor 2, that makes use of three cameras, and you should now find the graphics to move really smoothly as you drive, and the monsters and background should move smoothly as you chug along at max speed! Hopefully the lines in the mines textures have been eliminated.[/p][previewyoutube="pFUHYmmrAB0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Every good thing though does come at a cost and here the cost is that the train is now permanently above the zombies so you will always be able to see your locomotive, but enemies can now appear underneath (such as the jumpers). Also your projectiles and wrecking ball can also obscure the console UI at the bottom of the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/b02b551244f732c9a0a5658474482d25a76ae2a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Best wishes,[/p][p]GTGD[/p]

notes.title: A new terrifying section of track - Raincoat Facility
notes.notes: [p]Choo Choo Engineers!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/f3587e2cada29e9c83daa9efc3b1ded8d8ccb8cd.gif"][/img][/p][p]Our survivors have located a Raincoat Facility, and believe that this might be an origin site for some of the monstrosities that have been emerging! The site is under the control of insane Raincoat mutants and these monsters use jetpacks to do their jump attacks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/1da951879861bbd7165eaf80e6263c6a10443598.png"][/img][/p][p]If you have more than two victories you will see Raincoat Facility as a possible track section in your journeys. The Raincoat Facility can only ever be the fourth or fifth track section. These locations are very dangerous because they are packed full of monsters, but at the same time there are tons of resources because the sites are being actively maintained by the Raincoat mutants. There are hardly any survivors so we can only imagine that most of the Raincoat staff at this facility have been turned into mutants.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/72c7c5b75324940af00ca0706cf2f80da3b63a20.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/56cec207692261eacb92419ca802e404deeab3b4.png"][/img][/p][p]Advanced jets are also being used by these mutants and so far we’ve only encountered transporters that do not have weapons, but the mutants like to jump out of these transporters using their jetpacks so it is important to destroy transporters to eliminate sources of these mutants.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/750b46ea157a493d4e8d101772306d8d05880681.png"][/img]Good luck out there! [/p][p]GTGD  [/p]

notes.title: Bring in your own music! More guard tower improvements!
notes.notes: [p]Choo Choo Engineers![/p][p][/p][p]Those train journeys can be pretty long so now you can play your own music. Import your soundtracks through the Settings menu under Sound and Volume. You'll need to give the game permission to access the relevant folder on Windows or Mac and then you can import whatever music you want to! You can replace all of the soundtracks in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/512132b5d693a5bbe1ba8728dd5689dbe51d58e8.png"][/img][/p][p]The Guard Tower has received an update and there are now two Turrets on either side of the guard tower. These can be upgraded from your upgrade menu once the guard tower is active. The grenade launcher on the guard tower has had a reduction in damage dealt because of the additional damage from the turrets.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/3d6d13334d3a098509d093ef7508b823160f2add.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/d05ae68837494f53b6915b3ab8e0b27cd7b01525.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/1903880d3b3954a25aec4ecf66061bd8096c3251.png"][/img][/p][p]The settings option for notch control by mouse wheel has been moved from the Misc menu to the Accessibility menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/4ba6adb8005e5527461af476f507f8dc8fb3757b.png"][/img][/p][p]Keep on winning![/p][p]GTGD[/p]

notes.title: The Mighty Smasher, 40 minute survival, Achievements, Mouse wheel for Notch!
notes.notes: [p]Choo Choo Engineers![/p][p]There is now the option to engage in a 40 minute survival challenge and fight a mighty boss! At 30 minutes monsters will gain 5x health, deal more damage and move faster. They also drop more money as well! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/644cfdc870013f236272148757bd21e7f956293f.png"][/img][/p][p]You can advance time quickly to 30 minutes by activating the guard tower which is at the 97% mark. Once activated you can upgrade the guard tower from your upgrade menu and it has a grenade launcher that does impressive damage and superb knock back (a throw back to the grenade launcher of Choo Choo Survivor 1). Swarms of monsters will then continue to attack you from 30 minutes onwards and you must survive to 40 minutes. Then a mighty version of the boss will emerge and you can choose to defeat it to utterly defeat the monsters. When a mighty boss is defeated all zombies will perish and you can proceed to the finish line in safety and calm. Btw, you can proceed to the finish line at anytime past 30 minutes if things are getting too tough and so still win the run.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/7a56193e12dec2fb8c99b3888ed213bd49dc172c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/d49c78b8d43b193bab875cb2711559c08ab42a97.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/3a13edd6b6ad9e3f603eccb8349319d943e40db9.png"][/img][/p][p]There are now local achievements for the playtest edition of the game. I haven’t integrated Steam achievements yet (might do for the playtest or maybe for the demo, but definite for the full game). This gives more direction on what to accomplish in the game and the mighty boss challenges are definitely for more skilled players, and some skilled players may still find the challenge easy! For everyone else though it will be challenging to survive![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/59b549a407504865500020a172d1691f19938f6a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/dd250faed0faea7b7219407f47e225a4f85323a2.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now change locomotive notch using the mouse wheel. Just turn it on from the misc menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/94f3b8867ff69b56eefdfe0817c2e6723a2f675b.png"][/img][/p][p]Keep on smashing through apocalypse![/p][p]GTGD[/p]

notes.title: The Odds of Survival! - Choo Choo Survivor Newsletter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/7d4b89b84d0932f18c308df49978cbafe084c1fc.gif[/img]

Choo Choo Engineers! Over the past two months some new dangers have emerged along with some great progress in improving the odds of our survival!

Mines are the latest type of track section to navigate through. They are filled with resources, danger and some survivors managing to hide down underground!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/4316eb3de2d5a03cda5a217ee5259e34ee48d86e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/5b0c65ae9e073a28e1b2f959a02b9cc4a3abc104.png[/img]

A few survivors have found a supply helicopter and they can get it flying again! Once the supply helicopter is working you can buy gold and steel from your upgrade menu using cash!

This section of track will appear very early in your journey at about 10%. Being able to buy gold and steel with money means that if you find a wall of zombies in front of you that seem too overwhelming then you can whittle them down and collect cash. Using your cash you can then order in gold or steel and then use that to upgrade your primary weapon power. A great strategy to ensure you never get stuck!

For $4,000 you can buy 3 gold, or 4 steel. If you have cash you can order in as many supplies as you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/be5759a9e1b81b0ca98ba6304354d8354f0fe6eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/1c2fddc40969d3948ebbc67f746f178bf2ebd5f2.png[/img]

Just defeating the boss and winning isn’t quite fun enough!
Mindless track zombies now emerge on defeating the "boss" monstrosity and we must blast them and drive to the end of the track (good old finish line from the first Choo Choo Survivor)! Some survivors think these zombies were once Raincoat researchers. Whatever they may be they do carry lots of money and protein bars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/48f090cee3e11aa4de7a0041c4823402a2113164.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/a843d1fa2c2dbf72877905372c2f29a1b3dc28a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/3e971bb54eba91d8fa540be18a5aed283f9d3223.png[/img]

Vampires and trains do not go together and there’s a vampire lord out there who feasts on survivors so it is only natural that the best thing to do is to destroy this nasty and rescue our survivors!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/43386b7452fe89d454ff2956bb5106d1da9ef10f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/5b79f703556dd07748062a7ab902f10da94358b5.png[/img]

A new locomotive and primary weapon has been brought online, The DRB Class 01.10 fitted with a lightning rod, and the Blaster energy weapon that leaves damaging flames! The Blaster is the most powerful primary weapon so far and the flames left behind by each blaster shot melt zombies in no time! The thrill of operating the blaster is like no other!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/0b19e81c0dfc45771cce1885b5f518fd510e791b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/9e5aeab4dd3b7a7c96c7a5750a1df5480a0694e4.png[/img]

Our Survivors have established a train depot and it is now possible to purchase passive upgrades (meta progression). These can be refunded as well if you want to focus on other abilities. Tons of upgrades to purchase already. Access these through the Unlock Abilities menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/07326db69840df539e84da444a5186ad085184dc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/552fcaaffcb3c4b641070a06ec2acaf50e0355cc.png[/img]

Keep on surviving Choo Choo Engineer and Never Give Up!
GTGD

notes.title: New Track Section - Mines! Also two new monsters have been sighted!
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

We've covered a lot of ground on our journeys, but the world is vast, and now we're coming across a new section of track! Mines!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/4316eb3de2d5a03cda5a217ee5259e34ee48d86e.png[/img]

Mines are rich in resources, but are a dangerous place to go, but at the same time great for survivors to hide in. The abundance of underground water in some of the natural cavern structures has enabled survivors to find a place to stay alive. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/df706e88ed9ff14feca2f9eabf6b873480aab55d.png[/img]

The mines appear to have portal like structures that can be destroyed and some strange mutant creature emerges from them. These creatures move quite fast but fortunately they seem to be relatively weak and are erased without much trouble! (Mine Terrors appear once you have three victories)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/5b0c65ae9e073a28e1b2f959a02b9cc4a3abc104.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/16c1c332e6d703ba8a902ccf2b7a8bd3eaa97af8.png[/img]

Another frightening monster that has been sighted appear to be ghosts that emerge from tombs. There is no solid explanation for their presence, though some researchers believe they are the detached spirits of the zombies, and are full of rage. Other researchers believe that the Raincoat corporation has figured out how to awaken these spirits. Whatever the case maybe, fortunately there are not too many sightings of these horrors. (Angry Spirits appear once you have two victories)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/55fb0d2b279d1c66f8e57bd79b41c947a0b01910.png[/img]

On a side note an experienced Choo Choo Engineer has discovered that chainsaws, modified cow catcher, regen and upgraded engine are an amazing combination and enable us to smash through the zombie horde and inflict massive damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527464/b0d402929598fb937a8d9762431c5e5477db1c61.png[/img]

Try out these changes in the latest version of the playtest here on Steam!

Good luck out there!
GTGD

notes.title: Survival or Extinction - Choo Choo Survivor Newsletter
notes.notes:
Choo Choo Engineers!

Matters are getting worse and the zombie hordes are becoming more powerful and continuing to mutate. More cities have fallen and survivors are becoming fewer in number. In Choo Choo Survivor 2 it is up to you to rescue as many survivors as you can.

Fortunately survivors are survivors for a reason, they never give up! So far your people have managed to bring back online two locomotives; an SD40 and an FP7, both reliable diesel electric locomotives from a previous era. They’ve taken inspiration from another Choo Choo Engineer from about a year ago who had restored a KiHa 183 and fit laser beams on it!

Currently your people have managed to develop some awesome auxiliary systems; 

A lightning rod that calls down lightning from the sky damaging everything in a radius and even stunning zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/4fdee978e947f8688b011103f5b97e2f34545feb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/b09f20a3578dabc6425d0aa865c6fc6a7d86174c.png[/img]

Chainsaws and a chainsaw drones that continuously circle your locomotive with a chance to instantly kill any zombie struck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/6dd7c8dc97dd005f04d0d493d6fb6bcf806dd27e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/dc413911db3169eb5828cf5ffbb555bb493bf92f.png[/img]

Flamethrowers that incinerate everything in their path and one of your people has even established contact with an ancient sleeping dragon named Boba. Even Boba is horrified at what has become of the world and is keen to help you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/f0c2b43300767c725cd761bab1cd3a415b487b18.png[/img]

Shurikens and a bouncing saw blade that are truly deadly. Ancient Ninja tech at its best!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/27a89b4f774427697b49c6aad8331ad497bb6e11.png[/img]

And of course the classic upgradeable cow catcher, but this time your people have managed to also install a machine gun that fires forward with exploding bullets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/35a01e241454f17a6b27c836f7a549380f4d3af9.png[/img]

As you gain more victories against the zombie horde your people will surely develop more impressive auxiliary systems.

A terrifying new zombie was sighted recently that explodes on dying. The only solution seems to be to blast these zombies as soon as possible or drive past as fast as possible! Fortunately there seem to not be too many of them and sightings are not that common.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/f3e638499517e7b12977b1208357022084950c92.png[/img]

Cabooses and carriages are not easy to access but fortunately some survivors have managed to keep these operational and use them as safe houses. Stopping to attach their carriage is a great idea and they are able to benefit your journey immensely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/61e05f107dd1783c6f4ad313105d7836d2369faa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/9319895b9eebdf967322418e55aa9760c61b965d.png[/img]

The zombies and monsters seem to be under some sort of control and have erected a bizarre dungeon like structure and there another ancient and horrifying creature has taken it as its home. A beholder it seems that fires a laser beam from its eye. This horrid creature has destroyed many a train and many Choo Choo Engineers have met their demise before it. Defeating this creature though will allow you to gain an auxiliary system from a past defeated train.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/6ccdffdf015578892422113f7542083a4eb98df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/ecd63d8ccb620e28f32bed568936138ef20b90cf.png[/img]

Some survivors are doing their best to group together and stay alive and on your journey you are likely to find their home and shop! Buy an auxiliary system, resources, or hire survivors to support them and yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/2b6cc38c1134c656540116c7b53575553b8fe78d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/eff85c64cd4d6e95db1d9be1b56a1a8a47cec94d.png[/img]

A large powerful monstrosity must be defeated at the end of each run. Where these terrifying creatures are coming from is not clear but some have noted that a container with markings “RAINCOAT” can be seen not far away from them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/4f95ddcd71c43c12624af9910cc31acfe174fac9.png[/img]

Select your journey wisely and proceed carefully. It’s up to you to save what is left of humanity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/f36d7240acf986ee6d97c5b72e205e0036e77c71.png[/img]

Note from Dev:
Wishlist Choo Choo Survivor 2 and join the playtest to have your say. More content will be coming to the playtest over the coming weeks for you to experience and enjoy!

Best of luck
GTGD

notes.title: Let's Go! The Beta is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

I've been hard at work on the railroad and made it to the launch of the playtest! Let me know how you like the game in the Steam community hub! If you're a streamer then please feel free to make videos. 

The playtest has one boss to defeat, two locomotives (you have to unlock the FP7) and two weapons (you have to unlock the wrecking ball). I'll be working on relics and that will probably come in the demo version when we get there. Ok lots more work for me to do!

Thanks and enjoy everyone!
